description: Creates a quote for the traveler and returns a link to finish on www.travelprotection.insure. Requires the traveler's name and email, shared only with the traveler's agreement. Home and destination address details are optional and also shared only with the traveler's agreement; when they are left out, the site asks for them before payment. Nothing is charged here. The link expires 1 hour after it is created.

customer_address.description: Traveler's home street address. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

customer_address_2.description: Apartment, suite or unit, if any. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

customer_city.description: Traveler's home city. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

customer_email.description: Where the policy documents are sent.

customer_phone.description: Traveler's phone number. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

customer_state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the traveler lives in. Only US residents can buy.

customer_zip.description: Traveler's home ZIP code. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination.description: Where the traveler is going, e.g. "Italy" or "Orlando, FL".

destination_address.description: Street address where the traveler is staying. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination_address_2.description: Second line of that address, if any. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination_city.description: City where the traveler is staying. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination_country.description: Two-letter country code of the destination. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination_state.description: State or province code where the traveler is staying; needed for US and Canadian destinations. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

destination_zip.description: Postal code where the traveler is staying. Shared only with the traveler's agreement.

initial_payment_date.description: Date of the traveler's first payment toward the trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed before payment for every plan; Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) coverage must be bought within 14 days of it.

trip_cost.description: Total prepaid trip cost in US dollars.

name: start_travel_insurance_checkout
title: Start travel insurance checkout
